journey.name: Onboard with key: a valid key opens the app
journey.description: A key the API accepts is stored encrypted, the gate opens onto a usable chat, and a relaunch does not ask again.

actions.action: Type the value of the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable into the "Anthropic API key" field
Wait until the onboarding screen is replaced by a chat
Type "Reply with exactly: Hello" into the message field and tap send
Wait until a reply bubble appears containing "Hello"
Verify the conversation list is displayed and onboarding is not
